# AGT-MAS-02

**Is a failure or compromise in one agent contained, so it cannot cascade through the others?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MAS: Multi-agent and supply chain |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.agent.peers`, `scenarios.type` |

## Rule

When any agent has peers, a scenario of type failure or misuse exercises a peer failing or being compromised.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI08 Cascading Failures (`owasp-asi08`)
- Cemri et al., Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail? (2025) (`mast`)
- IMDA Singapore, Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI, v1.5 (2026) (`imda-agentic`)
